text_block_list.text: "The piece we perform today sings the praises of the brilliant, spirited stars gathered for the Sapporo Kinen—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Titled: "Northern Summer Sky."
—Let us uncover the charm of this race!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, the Sapporo Kinen is about to start.
I wonder who'll come out on top~

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe.
I prepped thoroughly with Earth's videos, after all.
I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I'm really hoping Earth takes the win~
She's definitely felt like she's on a roll lately.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I've been rooting for Earth lately, too.
I hope this gives her some good momentum heading into the autumn season.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah.
The crowd's reaction seems pretty great too.
